music_recording_and_listening_window_not.en: Nobody has listened to a recording against this film, so the passage has no in-point and no out-point.
music_recording_and_listening_window_not.zh: 还没有人把录音和这支影片对着听过，所以乐段没有起点也没有终点。

playback_and_usage_conditions_not_checke.en: How this recording may be played, and on what terms, has not been checked.
playback_and_usage_conditions_not_checke.zh: 这段录音能怎么播、按什么条件播，还没查过。

distractors_need_reuse_review.en: The three wrong answers have not been checked for a product that used this same song.
distractors_need_reuse_review.zh: 三个错误选项还没核过：其中会不会有产品也用过这首歌。

distractors_not_reviewed.en: This card has no reviewed set of wrong answers yet.
distractors_not_reviewed.zh: 这张卡还没有经过复核的错误选项。

audio_asset_not_resolved.en: No specific recording has been settled on — only a title and an artist.
audio_asset_not_resolved.zh: 还没定下具体是哪个录音，只有曲名和艺人。

cue_not_auditioned.en: The passage has not been auditioned, so where it starts and ends is unknown.
cue_not_auditioned.zh: 乐段没有实听过，起止位置未知。

usage_permission_not_established.en: Permission to use this particular recording as a question's audio has not been established.
usage_permission_not_established.zh: 把这一个录音用作题目音源的许可还没有确立。

original_video_id_unresolved.en: The original film has not been pinned to a specific video.
original_video_id_unresolved.zh: 原片还没有定位到具体的一支视频。

track_identity_pending.en: Two sources disagree about which recording this is.
track_identity_pending.zh: 两个来源对这是哪个录音意见不一致。
